description:
A sales representative needs to set up the contact structure for a new multinational prospect. Create the following hierarchical contacts in Odoo's Contacts module:

1. Parent Company: 'Nexus Global Industries'
   - Type: Company
   - Address: 500 Park Avenue, New York, NY 10022, United States
   - Phone: +1 212-555-0100
   - Website: https://www.nexusglobal.example.com

2. Subsidiary Company: 'Nexus Global - Europe'
   - Type: Company
   - Parent Company: Nexus Global Industries
   - Address: 45 Moorgate, London, EC2R 6AN, United Kingdom

3. Subsidiary Company: 'Nexus Global - Asia Pacific'
   - Type: Company
   - Parent Company: Nexus Global Industries
   - Address: 2-3-1 Nihonbashi, Chuo-ku, Tokyo 103-0027, Japan

4. Individual Contact: 'Elena Rossi'
   - Type: Individual
   - Company: Nexus Global - Europe
   - Job Position: VP of Sales EMEA
   - Email: elena.rossi@nexusglobal.example.com
   - Phone: +44 20 7946 0958

5. Individual Contact: 'Kenji Tanaka'
   - Type: Individual
   - Company: Nexus Global - Asia Pacific
   - Job Position: Regional Director APAC
   - Email: kenji.tanaka@nexusglobal.example.com
   - Phone: +81 3-1234-5678

IMPORTANT: The parent-child relationships must be correctly established. The two subsidiary companies must have 'Nexus Global Industries' set as their parent company. Elena Rossi must be linked to 'Nexus Global - Europe' and Kenji Tanaka must be linked to 'Nexus Global - Asia Pacific'.
